levelPolicyZh.L0: 仅有位置或体量占位，不表达建筑真实结构。
levelPolicyZh.L1: 结构粗模，能够辨认主要体量，但比例与构造尚未校准。
levelPolicyZh.L2: 比例校准，建筑总长、总宽、层高、轴线与关键高差具有可追溯依据。
levelPolicyZh.L3: 立面细化，门窗、柱廊、檐口、屋脊、台基与主要装饰形成完整节奏。
levelPolicyZh.L4: 生产资产，具备PBR材质、UV、碰撞、LOD、光照与性能验收。
levelPolicyZh.L5: 1:1高精度资产，尺寸和主要构造经图纸、测量或摄影测量交叉核验，并完成误差记录。

levelPolicyEn.L0: Position or mass placeholder only; no claim of architectural structure.
levelPolicyEn.L1: Recognizable structural blockout without calibrated proportions or construction.
levelPolicyEn.L2: Traceable calibration for overall dimensions, storey heights, axes, and key elevation changes.
levelPolicyEn.L3: Complete facade rhythm for doors, windows, colonnades, cornices, roof ridges, plinths, and major ornament.
levelPolicyEn.L4: Production asset with PBR materials, UVs, collision, LOD, lighting, and performance acceptance.
levelPolicyEn.L5: 1:1 high-fidelity asset with major dimensions and construction cross-verified by drawings, measurement, or photogrammetry, including an error record.
